Chief_Complaint.source_text: CC: Breathing difficulties after wasp sting

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Stung by wasp while gardening approximately 15 minutes ago
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Stung by wasp while gardening ~15 min ago

History_of_Present_Illness.content: After being stung by a wasp, patient ran inside

History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: now shallow breathing and chest tightness
Lip symptoms: Tingling/tingling sensation in lips

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient denies sensation of throat closing
Patient notes a bit of blotching of the skin

Medications.content: Has antihistamines at home used for flying due to aerosinusitis
Medications.source_text: Has antihistamines at home (used for flying; reports "aerosinusitis")

Social_and_Family_History.content: Wife is present with the patient
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: Support: Wife present and calling ambulance

Assessment.content: Suspected systemic allergic reaction to wasp sting with respiratory involvement, lip paresthesia, and cutaneous blotching, with concern for evolving anaphylaxis
Assessment.source_text: 1. Suspected systemic allergic reaction to wasp sting — respiratory involvement (shallow breathing, chest tightness), lip paresthesia, cutaneous blotching; concern for evolving anaphylaxis.

Assessment.content: Atopic background with eczema and documented penicillin allergy
Assessment.source_text: 2. Atopic background: eczema; documented penicillin allergy.

Plan_of_Care.content: Arrange ambulance with wife instructed and calling emergency services immediately
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Immediate: Arrange ambulance — wife instructed/calling emergency services now.

Plan_of_Care.content: Administer oral antihistamine now while awaiting ambulance
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Give oral antihistamine now while awaiting ambulance.

Plan_of_Care.content: Proceed to emergency department for urgent assessment and management
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Proceed to ED for urgent assessment and management.
